text: The SDK fixed password handling to hash passwords and added tests to verify the changes.

The SDK introduced service registration, rotating refresh tokens, and password hashing for better security, with documentation added. The network build process was adjusted to use self‑hosted runners, and the investor dashboard received design and accessibility improvements.

The network milestone audit was completed and related documentation recorded, and new payout address getters were added to network accounts. The SDK added support for idempotency keys, and the wallet now reports a real count of processed jobs.

Investor tools added new lockout scenario calculations and improved value formatting, while the SDK introduced a payout address function and refined its runner configuration. Additional updates improved third‑party storage handling and added a numeric keypad component to the client scaffold.
An outdated AI submodule was removed from the system, and the network’s backup and cold‑storage handling were updated to improve data retention and logging.
The network documentation was expanded with a roadmap and requirement list for the upcoming version, and the backup system was updated to support a tiered archive and light node model.
The wallet added temporary diagnostic output to its verification process to aid debugging.
A fix merging a bootstrap update and test work aligning trimmed‑marker handling were applied to the blockchain network. Automated processes ran for another repository.

A new durability check called guard‑5 was added to the blockchain, and test work for live scenarios was performed. The SDK scaffolding received overrides for user lists and new role seeds, and third‑party resolution settings were updated.

The network plan was revised and test items were recorded, while documentation of phase execution was added. Pagination handling was corrected and documentation trimmed, and a new evidence matrix and related test scenarios were added to the blockchain component.

The blockchain network added a new research phase, fixed protocol declarations, and upgraded components, while also adding seal‑growth testing. Documentation was updated to clarify template forwarding, correct include paths, and synchronize document hashes.

The blockchain network fixed several open research items, added more testing, and refreshed documentation, while a downgrade feature for interlock gates was introduced and escrow‑release documentation was updated. The SDK received a hardening update and the cognitive system added a keystore concurrency test.

The blockchain network received upgrades to SuperGenius pointers and added test work for phase 19 rulings, along with updated documentation of checkpoint rulings and planning matrices. SuperGenius added test work and documentation for verified escrow‑release plans.

The wallet application received fixes to its startup messages and name‑change behavior, plus a configuration tweak. The blockchain network component was repaired to clean up records, adjust funding handling, and added test work.
The blockchain component received a fix for missing build stubs and a compose load problem. A test adjustment was made in the cognitive system to incorporate a compiler fix.

Several fixes and upgrades were applied to the network dispatch system, and documentation was updated for runner settings. The SDK’s generated models were refreshed, and a new architecture‑review capability was added to the cognitive system.
